address: 80/30 Mu 3, Suan Uthit Road, Bo Phut, Ko Samui, 84320, Thailand
bio: Phensiri is a must-visit for Thai and Southern Thai cuisine. Using high-quality local ingredients, the chef-owner ensures each dish is well-balanced and flavourful. A no-fuss approach delivers authentic flavours, with the spice level adjustable to your liking. The welcoming atmosphere is enhanced by Thai-style décor, and the attentive staff, fluent in English, make things easy for tourists. Popular with both locals and visitors, it is especially busy at lunchtime and dinner....
